Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Need an official answer:

Since the vampire striking with Catatonic Fear is having his strike's
damage dealt in some phantom strike resolution phase,

(S:CE terminates strike resolution before any damage is done [RTR])

do his retainers (Wolf Companion, etc.) deal their damage during that
strike resolution phase? Even though the opposing minion's retainers won't
be afforded the same consideration?

----------

Card text from WotC:

Catatonic Fear
Presence
Combat
Strike: combat ends
* As above, and the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution.

--
